mentions.name: fullremote.it
mentions.description: An Italian-oriented curated remote-jobs and remote-work community with ~10k subscribers across a newsletter and Telegram. Started as a side project sharing good remote roles and is turning into a real business with paid job postings, sponsorships, and coaching for companies and developers.
mentions.audience: Developers seeking remote work and companies hiring remotely in Italy
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://fullremote.it, which started as a side project and is now turning into a real business.

It's an "italian-oriented" curated remote-jobs and remote-work community, currently ~10k subscribers across newsletter and Telegram. What began as "let's share good remote roles" is evolving into paid job postings, sponsorships, and coaching for companies and devs.
